units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:3">Ab. I, 3</cite>, a. fr. <he>מ׳ שמים</he> the fear of the Lord.

<cite ref="Berakhot 28b:10">Ber. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>שתהא מ׳ שמים עליכם כמ׳ ב״וד</he> (Ms. M. <he>שיהא</he>) that your fear of the Lord be as great as the fear of man (before whom you hide yourselves when you want to do wrong).

<cite ref="Kiddushin 31a:1">Kidd. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>הקדים הקב״ה מ׳ האם למ׳ האב</he> the Lord (the Bible text) places the reverence due to the mother before that due to the father (<cite ref="Leviticus 19:3">Lev. XIX, 3</cite>). Ib.ᵇ <he>איזהו מ׳</he> whereby is filial reverence shown?; Sifra K’dosh., beg. <he>איזו היא מ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:2">Ab. III, 2</cite> <he>שאלמלא מוֹרָאָהּ וכ׳</he> but for the fear of it (the secular government) &c.; a. fr.—Fem. form <cite ref="M00609"><he>מוֹרְאָה</he></cite>, constr. <cite ref="M00609"><he>מוֹרְאַת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 15:17">Num. R. s. 15</cite> <he>מורא זו … מ׳ הרב</he> this ‘fear’ (<cite ref="Ecclesiastes 8:13">Koh. VIII, 13</cite>), we know not what it refers to; but on reading … (<cite ref="Leviticus 19:32">Lev. XIX, 32</cite>) we learn that it means the reverence due to one’s teacher.

<cite ref="Leviticus 19:32">Ib.</cite> <he>הרי מ׳ רבית ומ׳ משקלות</he> there is also the warning to fear the Lord attached to the prohibition of usury (<cite ref="Leviticus 25:36">Lev. XXV, 36</cite>) and of false weights (ib. XIX, 36).—

<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 9:5">Naz. IX, 5</cite>, v. <cite ref="M00628"><he>מוֹרָה</he> II</cite>.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 78:11">Yalk. Sam. 78</cite> <he>מה הדין מ׳ … הדין מ׳</he>, read: <he>סירא … סערא</he>, v. Midr. Sam. ch. II.]
